prompts: New furniture atlas for a compact Brazilian church of Padre Fabio, matching the supplied scene's altar-at-north, symmetrical wooden pews and open central blue aisle, but in the game's own 2D topview RPG pixel-art projection. Use reference as composition and mood guidance, not an exact copy. Exactly TEN isolated sprites arranged in 5 columns x 2 rows, reading left to right top to bottom, landscape 1536x1024, transparent RGBA. Crisp square pixels, dark outlines, small clustered highlights, no painting or smoothing, no soft halos, cast shadows, scene background, labels or cell grid. Warm dark wood, gray-violet stone, blue cloth with modest gold trim, cream linen, amber candles. Same logical pixel density. Every full object fits inside its cell with transparent padding. Order: 0 altar of dark wood, cream altar cloth and two small candlesticks plus a modest gold cross, viewed from front and top; 1 wooden church pew facing NORTH toward the altar, seen from behind by the player at south, with visible backrest and seat top, never a front-facing bench; 2 wooden lectern with open Bible on top and a tiny candle; 3 compact church archive bookshelf with books, registers and a small wooden cupboard; 4 small wooden church organ with keyboard and short pipes, front-and-top view; 5 low octagonal gray stone baptismal font with visible blue water bowl; 6 carved gray-violet stone column with square base and modest capital; 7 narrow amber and blue stained-glass church window in a dark stone frame; 8 long NARROW vertical blue carpet runner with small gold trim and sparse modest motifs, actual proportion roughly 1:4, complete tasselled ends, never stretch a square rug; 9 narrow blue church banner with a simple gold cross on a wooden pole. All ten sprites complete and separate. The objects will furnish a small church using existing stone and wood textures. No character, door, weapons or giant gothic castle ornament. 2D topview RPG, not isometric; lower and upper visible surfaces consistent with the reference camera.

Edit ONLY the wooden pew, the SECOND object in the TOP row. Leave the other nine objects and their placement exactly unchanged. The pew must face NORTH toward an altar above it in a topview RPG. We view its BACK from SOUTH: draw the broad exterior wooden back panel on the LOWER / foreground side of the sprite, with a slim glimpse of the seat BEHIND it on the UPPER / north side. The back panel occludes the seat; do not show a front-facing seat with books in front of a backrest. Same dark wood, warm trim, squared pixel art, size and full silhouette as existing pew. This is a newly drawn rear view, not a rotation or flip of the old picture. No new object or labels. Keep all ten items separate on transparent RGBA. Preserve altar, lectern, archive, organ, font, column, window, runner and banner exactly.
